premises.text: Hair industry is offline so clients struggle to find stylists and professionals lack digital tools
premises.evidence_span: the industry isn't online, and so it's hard to find a stylist

premises.text: Stylists lack websites, CRM, email marketing, online schedules, and business measurement
premises.evidence_span: She doesn't have a website. She doesn't track client information or send marketing emails. She doesn't have daily access to her schedule

premises.text: Professionals get a branded website with social share buttons and specials to grow via client sharing
premises.evidence_span: Glenda gets her own website. So for the first time, she can actually control her visibility online

premises.text: Clients search, sort, book online including last-minute, and get reminders plus review prompts
premises.evidence_span: type in haircut San Francisco, get a search results page with a bunch of professionals in my area

premises.text: Dashboard, education, photo inspiration, and busy/free specials help professionals grow revenue
premises.evidence_span: we give her a dashboard with an overview. So she has key information about her business

premises.text: Mobile apps extend the platform to iPhone, Android, and iPad
premises.evidence_span: we have an iPhone app, an Android app, and an iPad app that are pending approval in the iTunes store

premises.text: Freemium free booking and scheduling opens the product to the whole industry
premises.evidence_span: freemium model, free online booking, free scheduling, so we're available for the entire industry

domains.name: Offline stylist discovery and ops gap
Client marketplace and pro growth tools

value.text: Bring hair professionals online so they can be found, booked, and grow
value.evidence_span: bringing this $40 billion industry online starting today

causal_links.evidence_span: Glenda can actively grow her business

notes: Independent run: mobile apps kept as delivery premise. Future optimization and $18B inefficiency treated as vision framing (4.1(4)). Traction excluded.
